Super Crazy Glue Clear - Strong Cyanoacrylate (CA) Glue for Plastic, Metal, Wood, PVC, Fast Curing Epoxy Adhesive | 3 Pack, 3.5 Oz.; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this for small repairs involving metal, plastic, and wood, alongside my existing tapes and resin.
ItemID: NA; Title: 100 Nitrile Exam Gloves 3.5 Mil - Latex & Powder Free, Disposable Non-Sterile Protective Gloves By PlastCare; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Disposable gloves would be useful for messy adhesive work, though I would check their suitability for the materials involved.
ItemID: NA; Title: ZIRO 3D Printer Filament,Matte PLA Filament 1.75mm,Multicolor Rainbow PLA Filament,1KG/2.2lb,Matcha; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am focused on fastening and workshop repairs, and I have no current need for printer filament.
ItemID: NA; Title: #14 x 3/4" Flat Head Phillps Drive Self Tapping Screws, 304 Stainless Steel, Cross Recessed Countersunk Head Wood Screws, 30 PCS; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Stainless fasteners interest me, but I would wait until a project calls for this particular diameter and length.
ItemID: NA; Title: #4 x 5/8" Pan Head Phillps Drive Self Tapping Screws, 304 Stainless Steel, Cross Recessed Pan Head Wood Screws, Sheet Metal Tek Screws, 100 PCS; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose these for small fastening jobs where a pan head and stainless steel are useful, after checking the dimensions.
